name: Paneer and Peas Breakfast Paratha
ingredients: ½ cup green peas, cooked and mashed
steps: Knead flour with a pinch of salt and enough water into a soft dough. Cover and rest 10 minutes.
Mix paneer, mashed peas, cumin, amchur, chilli and coriander. Season lightly.
Divide dough into four balls. Roll two into small discs.
Place filling on one disc, cover with another and seal edges; dust lightly with flour.
Roll gently and cook on a hot tawa, brushing each side with a little oil, until golden and cooked through.
note: Vegetarian, not vegan. Makes two generously stuffed parathas; serve with plain yogurt if desired.
